newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ABB wins India oil refinery order.
newsitem.headline: ABB wins India oil refinery order.

text.p: Electrical engineering group ABB Asea Brown AG said it had won a contract worth more than $500 million to build one of India's first private sector oil refineries.

ABB said in a statement that the contract was placed by Essar Oil Ltd. and covers the supply of equipment and materials for the Essar Refinery, presently under construction at Jamnagar, in the western part of India in Gujarat state.
The refinery is being built on a greenfield site and is designed to produce nine million metric tonnes of refined oil per year.
The customer, Essar Oil, is a member of the Essar Group, one of India's largest business houses with assets exceeding $3 billion and with wide engineering interests, including power, oil and gas.
Under a separate contract, ABB is also responsible for the overall project management in the construction of the entire refinery complex.
